items.name: srouter
items.description: Never hit rate limits again. One OpenAI-compatible endpoint for 60+ providers & 1,200+ models — smart auto-fallback, prompt compression, 60-language dashboard. Plug into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex & more. Free, open-source, self-hosted.

items.name: Varin
items.description: The open-source agent harness, ready out of the box and customizable in depth. Tools, context, durable execution, permissions and recovery for code, research and office work, with a long-running super-agent Bot that leads a team of agents.

items.name: sesori_apps_monorepo
items.description: Sesori iOS/Android app and the Sesori Bridge CLI — drive Claude, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Pi, OMP, Hermes coding sessions from your phone

items.name: BlocksBeyondTheStars
items.description: A block-based 3D space crafting game: explore procedurally generated planets across many star systems, mine and craft, tame creatures, build ships, bases and your own space stations — solo or with friends. Open-source .NET server + Unity client, self-hostable.

items.name: perry
items.description: A native TypeScript/JavaScript compiler written in Rust. Compiles TypeScript/JavaScript directly to executables using SWC and LLVM.

items.name: AgentsCommander
items.description: Stop letting your experience disappear between sessions. Build your own coding-agent ecosystem: keep roles, skills, and lessons in files you can review, refine, and reuse. Start with one agent or coordinate teams in real terminals. Open source, local-first, no telemetry.
